steps.text: Infiltration is rainwater soaking into the ground. Different soils let water through at different speeds. Let's race them.
Tap “Make it Rain” and watch the water soak into each soil.
Sandy soil has big gaps, so water rushes through fastest. Clay soil is packed tight, so water soaks in slowly.
Faster infiltration means more water reaches the groundwater below. Soil type decides how quickly rain soaks in.
